doc: A repository's .drgnx/settings.el seen by the scan (unified-settings Task 24; design §12): graph/put-parsed brings its shared settings in as parsed option entities of the repository's project, written by scan:<root> (system, tool scan); a global id there refuses its source; a shared setting you changed in Settings takes the repository's next change as a new version of the scan's.

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/work/alpha/.drgnx && cd $ROOT/work/alpha && export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1700000000 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1700000000 +0000' && git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q --allow-empty -m alpha && printf '((nil (fill-column 80)))\n' > .drgnx/settings.el

sql: select substr(id, 9) from entity where kind = 'project'

select e.origin, e.source, t.actor, t.class, t.tool, e.project = (select n from entity where kind = 'project'), json_extract(e.data, '$.value') from entity e join tx t on t.id = e.created_tx where e.kind = 'option'

select e.ver, json_extract(e.data, '$.value'), t.tool, (select tool from tx where id = h.tx_from) from entity e join tx t on t.id = e.updated_tx join entity_hist h on h.n = e.n and h.ver = 2 where e.kind = 'option'
select count(*) from entity where kind = 'option'
